name: Russian Twist
summary: A seated rotation that trains the obliques and trunk. Start with bodyweight and add light weight only when your form is solid.
setup: Sit on the floor with the knees bent and lean back to about 45 degrees with a straight spine.
Lift the feet slightly or keep them on the floor for an easier version.
Hold your hands together in front of the chest.
execution: Rotate the torso to one side, bringing the hands past the hip.
Return through the center and rotate to the other side.
Keep the chest tall and the movement slow and controlled.
Count each side as one rep.
mistakes: Rounding the back: sit tall and reduce the lean.
Swinging only the arms: turn the shoulders and ribcage.
Rushing with momentum: slow down for control.
Using too much weight: add load only after the form is solid.
